jest.retryTimes(1);
let attempts = 0;
describe('checkout', () => {
  test('passes @C-1@v1', () => expect(1).toBe(1));
  test('fails', () => expect(1).toBe(2));
  test.skip('skipped', () => {});
  test.todo('todo');
  test.each([1, 2])('parameter %i', n => expect(n).toBeGreaterThan(0));
  test('retry', () => expect(++attempts).toBe(2));
});
